spending_entity: Agence Nationale des Systèmes d'Information de l'État (ANSIE)
programme: Agence Nationale des Systèmes d'Information de l'État (ANSIE)
purpose: The whole operating and investment budget of the state's information-systems agency, which runs government networks, the data centre and shared platforms such as the X-Road exchange layer.
scope_basis: Single-mandate body: ANSIE was created by law 100/AN/15 to build and run the state's information systems, so its whole budget is a digital line (the spec's single-mandate carve-out). It is a public administrative establishment under the Presidency, which proposes the arrêté.
amount_scale: full Djibouti francs as printed (FDJ); the article prints no scale factor
doc_locator: Arrêté n° 2023-189/PRE (signed 31 Dec 2023, eJO 30 Jan 2024), article 1, En Charges; actual: Loi n° 210/AN/25/9ème L approving ANSIE's 2024 accounts (companion 2026-03-26-dji-ansie-comptes-financiers-2024-companion), article 1er, En charges
notes: Cross-foot: the arrêté sets products and charges equal at 451,743,675, the only split it prints; the 2024 accounts show products 457,088,876 against charges 479,221,862, a 22,132,986 deficit (derived, not printed). Stage: deliberated by the board on 3 Dec 2023, heard by the Council of Ministers on 26 Dec 2023 and made executory by presidential arrêté, so appropriated; the accounts were approved by law in Feb 2026 and are the outturn, not an audit opinion. No execution rate: the accounts' charges are an accrual income-statement total while the budget's charges include investment (the Council's 2026 record splits ANSIE's budget into operating and investment), so the two are not on one basis. Funding source unstated: the arrêté prints products as one figure; the Council's 2026 record says the agency lives mainly on a state subsidy plus service receipts. The subsidy's line in the state budget is not visible because the annexed budget document is unpublished, so nothing is counted twice. Both HTML artefacts md5-matched to lookups/artefact-md5-index.csv.

Funding source unstated: products are one figure with no source named. No 2024 accounts for INSTAD are published in the eJO, so no actual. The subsidy's line in the state budget is not visible (annexed budget document unpublished), so nothing is counted twice. HTML artefact md5-matched.
